primitives.name: Player Identity Cross-Reference
primitives.verbatim_quote: This is a ready-made **cross-reference crosswalk** between every other feed in this KB.
primitives.assumptions: All identifiers map bijectively to unique NFL players; external feeds are consistent in naming and categorization.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When any external ID is missing or inconsistent, crosswalk integrity fails.

layer2.mapping: Maps distinct player identity schemas into a unified relational space for inter-feed alignment.
layer2.telemetry: Cross-reference completeness rate across all feeds.

primitives.name: Statistical Projection Vector
primitives.verbatim_quote: `extracted_data/sleeper_nfl_week7_projections_2026-10-22.csv` — 3,047 skill-position rows (QB/RB/WR/TE) with pass/rush/rec stat projections and PPR points.
primitives.assumptions: Projections are independent and normally distributed around mean values; PPR scoring is fixed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Projection variance exceeds threshold due to injury or matchup anomaly.

layer2.mapping: Derives expected fantasy contribution from base statistical projections using scoring rules.
layer2.telemetry: Mean absolute error of projected vs actual stats.
